svg.title: Export To .rdk Project
svg.desc: Export To .rdk Project Automated Welding Path & Program Generation. A powerful FreeCAD add-on designed specifically for Robotic Welding applications. It eliminates manual coordinate entry by synchronizing design geometry with robot logic: Path Modeling: Design complex welding trajectories directly within the FreeCAD environment. Automatic Program Creation: The plugin extracts path data and generates ready-to-use robot programs in RoboDK instantly. Data Synchronization: Ensures that every vertex and edge of the weld seam is accurately translated into robot targets.
